style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: If you don’t own dlc “⟦0⟧ then you don’t have access towards most of the new faction system. If you don’t want your mod to be dependent on dlc ownership but still want to use basic faction you can do ⟦1⟧.

Faction with DLC is really modable in almost every aspect of it for you to change. Most of it based on ⟦0⟧, that contains rest of components of factions. It contains ⟦1⟧, icon, color, rules, ⟦2⟧. To create faction you still use ⟦3⟧.
⟦0⟧ - “quest” for multiple countries or leader country
⟦0⟧ - set of regulations used inside of faction
Color - color of faction used in faction map mode, if not specified uses leader color
⟦0⟧ - global, continuous goal that used to give faction a modifier or a rule depending on the conditions.
⟦0⟧ - a way to combine all above things

Faction’s goals are the way to have “quest” for multiple countries without using missions or events. There are three types of goals in the game, Short-term, Medium-term and Long-term. They are defined in
⟦0⟧ and every faction can have up to one of three types present in the game. ⟦1⟧ Default scope is faction leader, FROM is faction member who views current goal. ⟦2⟧.
It's not mandatory for faction to start with goals.
⟦0⟧ - id of your goal, must be unique.
⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ key for visible name of goal
⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ key for visible description of goal

⟦0⟧ Determines to which category goal would be assigned,there’s no difference between categories, but it’s good practice to have easier goal in short_term, medium difficulty goal inside medium_term, and long term goal inside long_term.
⟦0⟧ - group to sort goal, accepts ⟦1⟧ from focuses and any custom you make, creation of new one works exactly same as focus ⟦2⟧.
⟦0⟧ - makes goal "locked". Goal would become irreplaceable manually, unless you complete it.
⟦0⟧ - decide whether it's goal or ⟦1⟧. By default set to no (so it's a goal)

⟦0⟧- is a ⟦1⟧ block that continuously checks every frame if a condition was met, required to make the goal to be visible in the goal selection screen. Since it checks every frame, it's preferable to put country or DLC checks into allowed instead.

⟦0⟧ - is a ⟦1⟧ block that continuously checks every frame if a condition was met, required to make the goal available to be chosen in the goal selection screen. If conditions aren't met the goal wouldn't be possible to select, but difference with visible is that it will still be visible and display why it's not available to be selected when hovered over.

⟦0⟧ - is a ⟦1⟧ block that gets checked only at the game's start or when loading a save, primarily used to restrict an idea to a country (As ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧) and/or a DLC (As ⟦4⟧). If an goal's allowed is unfulfilled, it will never appear within the selection unless it becomes true on the save being reloaded; however, manual assignment via ⟦5⟧ bypasses the check. If left out, assumes to be always allowed. ⟦6⟧
⟦0⟧- is a ⟦1⟧ block that decides if a goal has been completed. Here you are supposed to put all conditions of goal that you want faction to complete. Default scope is the leader of the faction.
⟦0⟧ - is a ⟦1⟧ block that decides if a goal should be removed, once it's condition is true. Triggers the goal's cancel_effect.
⟦0⟧ - is an ⟦1⟧ block that executes effects for completing a goal, by default only the faction leader will get rewarded for completing goal. (Since default scope of goal is leader)
⟦0⟧ - is an ⟦1⟧ block that executes effects once a goal has been selected. ⟦2⟧
This block won't fire if goal is added through a faction template

⟦0⟧ - is an ⟦1⟧ block that executes effects once a goal has been removed. The only difference with ⟦2⟧ is that this effect will be executed if goal has been changed, while other only runs once a goal has been canceled because the conditions in it's ⟦3⟧ trigger have been met.

⟦0⟧ - is ⟦1⟧ block that execute effects once a goal has been cancelled. The only difference with ⟦2⟧ is that this effect will be executed if a goal has been canceled because it's cancel conditions have been met, the other will run if goal has been changed.

Goals mainly use ⟦0⟧ trigger with ⟦1⟧ to give rewards for complete goals. Even though it's primary way, it's not the only one to complete them. Ratio_progress is block that's turns goals into a continuous goals unlocking new potential way of using them. Imagine you want to base your goal around conquered land of certain faction or make it based on resource count of faction, maybe you want a quest to be complete once 80% of states in faction would have factories. That's all possible with ratio_progress.
⟦0⟧ - is a block where you can do all those cool thing mentioned above.
All these thing mentioned bellow must be used inside ratio_progress, otherwise they won't work.
⟦0⟧ - uses a collection to define the elements that are considered for completion.
⟦0⟧ - uses a collection to check which elements in ⟦1⟧ are complete
⟦0⟧ For more collections or info on how to use them see ⟦1⟧
This code will make goal 100% done, once faction leader or any faction member controls all african states
⟦0⟧ - variable, or fixed value, that defines maximum amount.
⟦0⟧ - variable, or fixed value, that defines amount you have completed already.
This code will make goal 100% done, once myVar will become 10, tooltip will show that you completed 8/10

You can't use the collection and non-collection versions of the same type e.g total_amount and total_amount_collection at the same time as they are mutually exclusive. However you can use total_amount_collection and completed_amount at the same time. Goal won't be completed if ratio reaches 100% unless auto_complete = yes used.
⟦0⟧ - is a block that contains sections, sections work like sections in ⟦1⟧. This can be used so that, when being within a certain threshold of completion, modifiers get enabled.
⟦0⟧ - minimal value for a milestone to become active. Percentual with 1 as maximum and 0 as minimum
⟦0⟧ - maximum value for a milestone to be active Percentual with 1 as maximum and 0 as minimum
⟦0⟧ - ⟦1⟧ a block that all members gets while a milestone is active.
⟦0⟧ - rules apply to all members while a threshold is active.

⟦0⟧ - automatically complete a goal if the progress reaches 100%, only works if ratio_progress is present in goal. Works with range and will make goal completed once range = { max = X } ratio is completed.
⟦0⟧ - overrides the default tooltip of the completed amount with any of your choice.
⟦0⟧ - overrides default tooltip of the total amount with any of your choice.

⟦0⟧ - defines how the ratio calculated above is mapped to the goal's progress, if max value = 0.8 it means that goal will be completed once the ratio between the total amount and the completed amount is be 80% or more. If min value = 0.2 it's means that if the ratio is 20% the goal 0% completed.
Both min and max are optional, by default min = 0, max = 1. Min can actually be greater than max, in which case the progress will increase as the ratio decreases and vice versa
⟦0⟧ - is a ⟦1⟧ that the faction leader gets once progress becomes 100% (works with range)
⟦0⟧ - is a ⟦1⟧ that the faction leader gets once progress becomes 0% (works with range)
⟦0⟧ decides on how likely ai will replace an empty goal slot with this goal, works exactly same as all other ai_will_do blocks in the game. For more information check ⟦1⟧
